text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Has everyone put their luggage in their 
rooms? Now then, regarding the schedule 
for the training camp—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Alrighty, here!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Yes, Turbo-san.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: I'm in for watermelon splitting!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, hey... First, we need to focus on 
training..."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It is just as Nature-san says. First, I 
will need you to complete the training 
regimen prepared here.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"However, I hear watermelon contains 
water, minerals, vitamins, and sugars, 
making it great for preventing summer 
fatigue."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I will adopt it. Let us 
incorporate it during break time.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ah, yeah. I figured you'd say that...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Watermelon splitting, huh... Way back, I 
tripped in a dip in the sand, smashed my 
face, and got a nosebleed... Ah, memories.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Then we just have to make sure Machitan is 
totally fine even if she trips!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Put a swim ring on my face! Now I'm 
totally fine! Turbo is a genius!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Eeeh, I have to stick my head through the 
swim ring hole to do the watermelon 
split?!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm... Is it really okay if I fall...?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
No, no, don't you worry your head about 
it. I'll keep an eye out so you don't 
fall.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I mean, look... y'know? About Ikuno's 
training plan...?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Please wait a moment. Since we added 
watermelon splitting, I will adjust the 
overall schedule.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ah, then add beach volleyball to the list 
too! And let's see, a barbecue and a 
festival too!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Uh-huh, uh-huh... Wait, what?! All you're 
doing is playing around?!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
As long as you complete the required 
training quota, there will be no problem.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
As long as it doesn't lead to overworking, 
it's a good way to refresh yourself. Going 
to see the fireworks sounds like a fine 
idea.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Are you sure!?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...I see, despite everything, it looks 
like Ikuno is in rather high spirits as 
well."
